reason: The bone framework has spaces for mineral, and the mineral resists compression, so their roles clearly fit the first goal.
expectation: The mineral will reinforce the bone framework.

alternatives.reason: I could investigate the muscle-building goal first, but the bone pairing is already clear.

effect: The mineral reinforced the living bones, and the next goal is to join them at the elbow.
reaction: It was useful to see that the hardened bone still contains living cells and vessels.
reason: The new goal directly connects the arm bones with the elbow joint.
expectation: The joint will connect the arm bones at the elbow.

alternatives.reason: I could investigate the separate muscle goal first.

effect: The bones now form a movable skeleton at the elbow; the muscle-bundle goal remains.
reaction: The picture helped me distinguish ligaments connecting bones from tendons connecting muscle to bone.
reason: The muscle cells need to form bundles, but the board doesn't clearly say how the supporting tissue helps, so I'll check their partners.
expectation: The compatibility list should show what can help build the muscle bundles.

alternatives.reason: The supporting tissue might help hold muscle cells together, but I'm not sure.

effect: The inspection automatically combined the cells and supporting tissue into muscle bundles with tendon ends; they can now be connected to the skeleton.
reaction: The time strip made it clearer how the separate cells become fibres and bundles.
reason: The goal calls for connecting the pulling tissue to the skeleton, and the bundles have tendon ends for that connection.
expectation: The muscle bundles will attach to the arm skeleton through their tendons.

effect: The completed arm shows how muscles on opposite sides both pull but move the elbow in opposite directions.
reaction: The two views made bending and straightening easier to picture.

mostWorthwhile.text: Connecting the muscles to the skeleton was most worthwhile because the two views showed how their positions produce opposite movements.

leastWorthwhile.text: Joining the bones to the elbow was clear but fairly predictable; the muscle assembly offered more to figure out.

surprise.text: I was surprised that hardened bone still contains living cells and vessels.

arbitrary.text: The need to combine muscle cells with supporting tissue was not obvious beforehand. The time strip helped explain the result afterward.

continue.text: I would choose to continue: seeing the separate bone and muscle projects come together made me curious about how another body system works.
